newsitem.title: CANADA: Rogers Communications Q3 shr loss.
newsitem.headline: Rogers Communications Q3 shr loss.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
Note: Full name is Rogers Communications Inc.

Third quarter results include a loss from discontinued operations of C$187,000 versus a loss of C$719,000 a year ago. Nine months results include a a gain of C$3,127,000 from discontinued operations and a loss of C$1,511,00 a year ago.

In the third quarter there was a special charge of C$67.4 million for cable restructuring charges. Rogers also incurred a charge of C$20.3 million at Wireless for first operation Time Division Multiple Access digital handsets and for the the exit costs from the closure of Wireless corporate store opeartions.
